create_EpisodeBatch: create an EpisodeBatch with a scheme, groups, batch size, and max sequence length for MARL episode data
update_EpisodeBatch: update an EpisodeBatch with new transition or episode data using batch and time slices
sample_ReplayBuffer: sample a random batch of episodes from a ReplayBuffer for training a multi-agent RL policy
insert_ReplayBuffer: insert an EpisodeBatch into a ReplayBuffer with automatic wraparound and buffer index management
slice_EpisodeBatch: slice an EpisodeBatch by batch index or time steps to extract subsets of episode data
